the part I really wanted you to read

A letter, from my heart.

Happy birthday, my girl. ♡ It still feels a little funny to think that you joined our college life in second year, and somehow, in the middle of all the ordinary days, you became one of my favourite people. Life has a way of bringing people into our story without telling us how important they will become. I know we have had misunderstandings. There were moments when I didn’t understand you the way I should have, and I’m genuinely sorry for the times I misunderstood you. I wish I had always paused, listened, and tried to see things from your side. You deserved that from me. But I’m grateful that our friendship also gave us something really wholesome: the comfort of talking, sharing what is on our minds, and feeling heard. One thing I appreciate about you is that you genuinely listen when I talk about my feelings. That may seem like a small thing, but it means more than you know. Being listened to without feeling silly or judged is such a rare kind of comfort. On your birthday, I hope you remember how much more there is to your life than anyone else’s expectations. I hope you get to chase the dreams that make your eyes light up, build a future you’re proud of, explore places you’ve always wanted to see, earn your own money, make your own choices, and become the woman you want to be. I hope you never feel that you have to rush your life just because the world thinks you should. You deserve time to grow, to discover yourself, to make mistakes, to change your mind, to fall in love with your own life, and to choose your future when you are ready. May you always have the freedom and courage to put your dreams on the table, too. I wish you a life with genuine happiness—not just the kind that looks good in photographs, but the kind that makes you feel peaceful when the day is over. I hope the people around you celebrate your wins, respect your boundaries, listen when you speak, and love you without asking you to become smaller. May this year bring you opportunities you never expected, confidence you can lean on, friendships that feel safe, and countless reasons to laugh that big, beautiful laugh of yours. When things get hard, I hope you remember that one difficult chapter is never the whole story. Thank you for being someone who has become special to me. I may not always say things perfectly, and we may not always understand each other immediately, but I truly wish good things for you. I hope you achieve the dreams you whisper about and the ones you haven’t even dared to say out loud yet. Happy birthday once again. Keep smiling, keep choosing yourself, and keep becoming. The world is wide, your life is yours, and I hope you get to live it in a way that feels deeply, unmistakably yours. With so much love, always. ♡
With so much love, always ♡
♡

May your life be full of joy, freedom, and beautiful beginnings.
